presentation.label: MIDI EXPRESSION
presentation.summary: Pitch bend, channel aftertouch and the mod wheel from MIDI IN reach the synth a MIDI track plays, on the route its notes take.
presentation.overview: Stock, the Digitakt passes the notes of an external keyboard through to the synth a MIDI track plays, but drops pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel. With SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU ticked, those messages follow the notes: on the AUTO CHANNEL to the active MIDI track, and on a track's own TRACK CHANNEL to that track, re-channelled to the track's CHAN and sent out of MIDI OUT. The sequencer's own notes and controls keep priority: expression waits while the DIN output is busy, and only the newest value of each control is kept. Unticked, MIDI handling is stock.
highlights: Play a synth through a MIDI track with pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel.
Follows the stock AUTO CHANNEL and TRACK CHANNEL routing of the notes, and each track's CHAN.
Sequencer notes and controls go out first; expression only uses free room on the DIN output.
Three SETTINGS rows; unticked, MIDI is stock.
usage: Connect a keyboard to MIDI IN on the AUTO CHANNEL and a synth to MIDI OUT.
Select a MIDI track, switch its CHAN on and set the synth's channel.
Tick PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU in SETTINGS, then play: bends, pressure and the mod wheel reach the synth.

access.location: SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU, MW THRU
steps: Use a build containing MIDI Expression for the original Digitakt on OS 1.54.
Press SETTINGS and go down to PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU, below SYSTEM, with UP/DOWN.
Press YES to tick or untick a row. RIGHT ticks it and LEFT unticks it.

controls.name: PB THRU
controls.doc: Ticked: pitch bend arriving at MIDI IN goes out of MIDI OUT on the CHAN of each MIDI track the notes on that channel would play. Unticked: dropped, as stock. Unticked at every power-on; not saved.

controls.name: AT THRU
controls.doc: Ticked: channel aftertouch, routed like PB THRU. Poly aftertouch is not passed. Unticked: dropped, as stock.

controls.name: MW THRU
controls.doc: Ticked, with PORT CONFIG > RECEIVE CC/NRPN ticked: the mod wheel (CC 1), routed like PB THRU, after the stock control-change handling. Unticked: CC 1 is handled as stock only.

limitations: Not saved: the three rows start unticked (stock) at every power-on.
Sends to DIN MIDI OUT only, not USB: the stock USB sender is not safe to call from the MIDI input task.
Only MIDI tracks A-H with CHAN on receive; audio tracks ignore pitch bend, as stock.
A MIDI track still sends its own PB, AT and MW values with its trigs, so a held bend jumps back at the track's next trig.
Changing the selected track while bending leaves the previous synth at its last value.

load.conditions: Measure under a flood of notes, CC, pitch bend, aftertouch and clock at the wire rate.

tests.summary: Emulator (digiemu): with the rows ticked, pitch bend, channel aftertouch and CC 1 reach a MIDI track's CHAN on the same route as the notes, from the auto channel and from TRACK CHANNEL; unticked, MIDI OUT is identical to stock; the stock CC handling is unchanged; beside FX Track and CC Recall. Hardware not yet tested.

license.declaration: Original work by tekomelu. The SETTINGS row follows the row record and OS 1.54 addresses FX Track documents (draadpiraat, GPL-3.0-or-later).
